source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3 ("Five Contests for Rural Council Seats")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'Twenty-four Councillors are returned unopposed'; the only nomination for the division in the full list (Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Strabane rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Four divisions were contested: Ballyfatton, Cullion, Douglas and Sion. The other twenty-four councillors were returned unopposed (Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3, which prints the full list of nominations; labels as printed). Returned unopposed.
